name: Toushouguu Akemi
source: A rich girl in class 3-A with excellent grades, is very popular with the boys and also admired by the girls in the school, Akemi does not brag about her status as a super rich girl and instead is very polite and friendly. She is very competitive with [url=/c65159]Saya[/url] in regards to their examination rankings.
translation: A rich girl in class 3-A with excellent grades, is very popular with the boys and also admired by the girls in the school, Akemi does not brag about her status as a super rich girl and instead is very polite and friendly.
